name: Y-state identity
summary: The two ways of writing the Pauli Y eigenstate as a single spider are equal up to a global phase.
description: An X-spider with phase −π/2 and a Z-spider with phase π/2, each with a single leg, both represent the +1 eigenstate of the Pauli Y operator, and are equal up to the global phase $e^{-i\pi/4}$.
